name: bahaospanov
description: Bakhtiyar Ospanov's Claude Code mods, built on function hooks.

plugins.name: git-gates
plugins.description: Gates git work on the user's word: no commit, push, MR opening or merge without their say-so in the current turn, a protected branch named, a grant for a commit per task; a negated keyword does not count.

plugins.name: git-tidy
plugins.description: Keeps git history tidy: commit messages in Conventional Commits with no Claude credit, then a Haiku review of the body; a push to a branch that already landed is refused; an MR whose branch lacks the target's latest commit is refused; a pushed series must leave the project working at every commit; follow-up commits and MRs carrying several features are held for the user.

plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Cleans up after merged work, once it shipped: removing a branch needs git, the forge or the user to say it merged; removing it or filling in its issue waits for the pipeline holding it to pass; merged, clean work is removed at the end of the turn, with one line saying what went.

plugins.name: issue-first
plugins.description: Feature work starts from an issue, and each commit names its own: a feat commit naming none is refused until Claude finds the issue, drafts one the user agrees to, or the user says it needs none; a commit whose subject does not end with the issue the user or the branch named gets a suggestion.

plugins.name: lean-docs
plugins.description: Docs worth keeping: docs-review asks Haiku whether new text will be read again, docs-no-repeat-code flags lines that may restate code, limit-docs shows a one-line notice when a turn adds too much prose.

plugins.name: lean-comments
plugins.description: Comments worth keeping: limit-edits flags comment-heavy edits, limit-turns shows a one-line notice when a turn's diff adds too many comments.

plugins.name: lean-scripts
plugins.description: Scripts worth keeping: scripts-review asks Haiku whether a new script could just be typed again when needed.

plugins.name: lean-tests
plugins.description: Tests worth keeping: static-text asks Haiku whether the text assertions a UI test gains only retype copy its component always shows.

plugins.name: close-countdown
plugins.description: A Herdr pane counts down before it closes: the agent calls close_pane_later, a band above the prompt shows the seconds left, and a typed message, Keep open or /keep-open cancels it while Close now closes it at once.

plugins.name: traffic-light
plugins.description: A band above the prompt says whether the session's work is done: green once its PR is merged into an integration branch and that push's pipeline passed, yellow while it waits on the PR or the pipeline, red when it needs you.

plugins.name: bahaospanov-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this repo's skills/ folder.
